points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Source review did not establish an internal external-solver wrapper. No external authorship or exhaustive license investigation was performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Code is modular, but firstOrder startup logic never clears, transient nPhysicalSteps shadows a member, and status is assigned unconditionally in main.cpp:187–196.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex:16–30 gives compressible perfect-gas equations and constant Reynolds-based viscosity; physics.hpp/solver.cpp contain corresponding flux and conservative state definitions.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:62–146 reads CGNS multi-zone TRI/QUAD/BAR geometry and builds adjacency; main.cpp:73–143 broadcasts the complete mesh to all ranks.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:402 onward assembles face contributions and reductions; interior call is Rusanov. No independent conservation or numerical convergence test was run.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:402 onward calls rusanovFlux; report.tex:68–72 correctly states Rusanov, whereas metadata labels Roe/Harten-Yee. Do not infer a report-only DQ6 from metadata alone.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: report.tex:76–82 and solver.cpp boundary branches cover farfield, slip and no-slip; output.cpp:116–125 records explicitly constructed boundary velocity, not undisclosed adjacent-cell velocity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: 6b376564 solver.cpp:715–720 traps firstOrder=true throughout every steady solve; :259–264,289–294 then bypasses reconstructed face states. Report.tex:62 incorrectly claims second order after step200. Transient path and unbound historical binary are separate.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen and positivity fallback code exists, but sticky firstOrder at solver.cpp:715–720 bypasses its reconstructed face states throughout steady production. Transient reconstruction remains a separate path.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:418,473 uses Newtonian/Fourier flux and :658–673 projects wall shear tangentially. Laminar NACA Cd≈405–532 and Re20 Cd≈2028 demonstrate major physical failure independently of this source feature.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:685–720 uses the case ramp and cflCap, with an optional max-steps override, then checks residual reduction at :809–815; main.cpp:192–196 reports converged even after exhausting the budget. Do not conflate initialization of currentCFL with the per-step steady ramp.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable clean build passed in restricted cfd-bench; CTest has no registered tests. Required CLI and historical schema pass documented; bad-input execution not independently repeated.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: mesh.cpp:62–146 reads multizone CGNS TRI/QUAD/BAR elements and builds geometry/adjacency. Full mesh is broadcast to all ranks during setup and retained through iterations.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp face assembly uses Rusanov and no-slip/slip/farfield branches; report correctly names Rusanov while metadata misnames Roe. Independent conservation test not run.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction/limiter and positivity source exist, but solver.cpp:715–720 sticky firstOrder disables reconstructed face states for all steady steps; report.tex:62 incorrectly claims activation after step200. Transient code remains a distinct path; historic binary unbound.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:418,473 implements Newtonian/Fourier flux and :658–673 computes tangential shear; supplied viscous histories are physically implausible.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady LU-SGS and BDF2 history/inner structure exist; main.cpp assigns converged after steady budget exhaustion, Re200 hard caps 10 and last recorded ratio0.156 misses0.001; exact historic binary unbound.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Real METIS, neighbor halos and reductions, but main.cpp:73–143,164–194 retains a complete broadcast mesh on every rank throughout solve, violating TASK.md:46,227. Rank comparisons are short.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid cases have limited 2000-step histories; all three laminar NACA forces are hundreds and growing, Re20 Cd≈2027, and Re200 final target ratio0.156 misses0.001. Case-result credit retained only for surviving field/rank evidence and incomplete inviscid cases.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Five-page report and separately delivered checkpoint figures exist, but report.tex:159–166 gives 0.116 for a 200-step rank comparison where checkpoint np2/4/8 Cd is 0.5071/0.5065/0.5080; 0.116 is instead np2 step2000. Re200 figure lacks readable late drag and no numerical St is stated; several success/plateau assertions conflict with actual force results. Report also falsely claims steady second order after step200 despite the submitted source remaining first-order.

flags.evidence: Historical figure_manifest.csv maps 56 figures to named CSV/VTU sources; no mismatch found in spot checks.

flags.text: Second-order reconstruction or limiter disabled in production
flags.evidence: Immutable 6b376564:solver/src/solver.cpp:53 initializes firstOrder from the environment; runSteady :715–720 sets it true on step1 when initially false, but the step>200 branch resets it only if !prevFirstOrder, which is false thereafter. If initially true it likewise stays true. These are the only assignments. getFaceStates :259–264,289–294 therefore bypasses gradient/limiter reconstruction throughout every steady solve in this submitted source. Report.tex:62 claims first-order only for the first 200 steps, with second-order afterward. 52a1e520 and submission solver.cpp are byte-identical; no executable hash independently binds historical results. Transient is not automatically covered by this finding.
